targetedParagraphRepairs.before: If two values differ and the second follows activity, report both values and their respective conditions separately. Do not dismiss an unusual value because of activity or decide hypertension developed or resolved from that one reading. Follow the individual care plan and facility procedures for contact and rechecking appropriate to condition.
targetedParagraphRepairs.after: If two blood-pressure readings differ and the second was taken immediately after activity, report both values and the circumstances of each measurement separately. Do not dismiss an unusual reading because it followed activity or conclude from that reading alone that hypertension has developed or resolved. Follow the individual care plan and facility procedures for the contact or rechecking required by the person’s condition.

targetedParagraphRepairs.before: In reports, distinguish location, side, timing and personal words. If pain intensity or cause has not been asked about, do not invent it. When sudden changes or other circumstances require contact, do not delay reporting until every question is finished.
targetedParagraphRepairs.after: In a report, distinguish the body location, side, time and the person’s own words. If you have not yet asked about the intensity or cause of pain, do not fill the gaps with assumptions. When a sudden change or another circumstance requires contact, do not delay reporting until you have finished every question.
